title: About
description: About the artist, and where to find their work.

text: I've decided not to try and explain exactly what is happening here. Doing so can only cause trouble for the work. It is a continuing, separate creative project that does not have any preconceived rules, boundaries or limits. I've writtten myself a blank check. That is about all I can tell you.

OK TO FAIL does have an online shop where objects of various sorts will become available. This is how I am able to continue to spend time and resources making this work. I appreciate your continuing support.

The shop is securely hosted by Fourthwall, an industry leader in the creative fulfillment space. All transactions are secure and handled by them directly. I never see your credit card details or any sensitive information.
